WILLIAMS LAKE, B.C. (CP) -- _RCMP_ are investigating the death of a man who fought with a police officer in the city jail after his arrest.
_Paul_ _Alphonse_, 67, died in hospital seven days later in the interior B.C. town, located 350 kilometres northeast of Vancouver.

_Alphonse_ was arrested around 4:45 p.m. on April 11 by a patrol officer responding to a complaint of an intoxicated man passed out in front of a store, according to an _RCMP_ news release. He and an officer were involved in an altercation in the detachment around 5 p.m. and _Alphonse_ was taken to hospital by ambulance 20 minutes later when he complained of chest pain.
_Alphonse_ was returned to the jail around 6:15 p.m. after being examined at the hospital but returned again four-and-a-half hours later when he continued to complain of chest pain.
_Alphonse_ died at Cariboo Memorial Hospital on April 18.
